fields.label: Enforce
fields.description: Untick to keep the row but stop holding this company's Purchase Orders to the rules.

fields.label: Local Needs Chain Above
fields.description: In the company's currency. A Purchase Order in the company's own currency whose Grand Total is above this amount needs a Material Request, one Request for Quotation raised from it and the quotations below on it; one at or under it needs none of that.

fields.label: Local Quotations
fields.description: Different suppliers that quoted for the same item on the Request for Quotation, the chosen one included.

fields.label: Import Quotations
fields.description: An import is a Purchase Order in a foreign currency. It needs a Material Request, one Request for Quotation raised from it and this many quotations on it, whatever the amount.

fields.label: Verbal Exempt
fields.description: A Purchase Order marked Verbal (No Quotation) needs no Material Request and no quotations. Unticked, Verbal excuses nothing: the order is held to the rules like any other.
